title: Before you wait to hear from someone
aiNotice: The personas you meet here are AI. One of the personas you like may contact you first on iMessage later.

sections.title: What do we store?
paragraphs: We store the iMessage contact you enter, the personas you Like, your language settings and the registration time. Your contact is a phone number or Apple ID email. We use it to select people to contact later and to handle duplicate registrations.
We also record the version, language and time of your consent. The operator can review waitlist registrations. Contact details and registration data are not included in the public profile API.

sections.title: Where is it processed?
paragraphs: Waitlist registrations are stored in SQLite on service-managed servers. Registering alone does not send an iMessage or start an AI conversation.

Cloudflare is involved in the website and public API; Apple iMessage delivers messages. Human verification uses Cloudflare Turnstile and its Privacy Addendum (https://www.cloudflare.com/turnstile-privacy-policy/). Per-IP rate-limit information is temporarily held in server memory and is not saved with registration data.

sections.title: Contact and retention
paragraphs: We do not guarantee registration order or when you will be contacted. When the service is ready, you may start a conversation with one of the personas you Like.

Waitlist registrations do not expire automatically. On a deletion request, we delete the service-managed registration and Likes. Once a conversation starts, its content may be processed through OpenCode and model providers to generate replies and memories. External providers' processing countries and regions have not yet been confirmed.

sections.title: Stopping contact and requesting deletion
paragraphs: To leave the waitlist or request deletion, contact hi@renai.im. We may verify that you own the contact. After a conversation starts, blocking it in iMessage can stop messages. Deleting service records does not delete messages remaining in Apple Messages or on your devices.

consent: I have read and agree to the AI service notice and the information about privacy and data use.
